body:
did you know: "cruel summer" took four years to become a no. 1.

it came out on lover in 2019 as an album track -- never even released as a single -- and still debuted at no. 29 on the hot 100, then fell to no. 71 the very next week and slipped off the chart. but swifties never let it go, and campaigned for it for years.

then the eras tour opened its lover set with it every single night. the singalong went viral (something like 2.3 million tiktoks deep), and in october 2023 -- four years, one month and three weeks after it first charted -- "cruel summer" finally hit no. 1. that's the fifth-longest climb to the top in hot 100 history. her 10th career no. 1, and lover's very first.

as taylor put it when it happened: "it's not even the summer anymore."
